name: speckle-bundle-spec
description: Single source of truth for the Speckle bundle format (eav + envelope + geometry). Schema and semantics live in spec/bundle-spec.sql; every package under packages/ is generated from it.

scripts.test: node tests/conformance/run.mjs && node tests/validator/run.mjs && node tests/query-conformance/run.mjs && node tests/release-gate/run.mjs
scripts.check: node codegen/generate-all.mjs && git diff --exit-code packages docs/reference.md
